schema: Periodic source health snapshot (every source, read through its own recipe). Each result carries reachability (`status`, `fetch_method`, `class`) and content (`content_verdict` relevant|webfetch-only|stale|irrelevant|shell|unreadable, with `content_alnum`, `content_terms`, `newest_item`, `newest_item_age_days`), and a derived `action` (none | needs-bridge | needs-demote | needs-content-fix | stale-content). The Ops dashboard floats only non-`none` actions.
